schema.description: A condition named in a document, as a point fact on the document's date. Written by hand readings, so far from the clinical notes on pathology requests.

as_written.description: The condition exactly as the document wrote it, abbreviations and case kept.

clinical_notes.description: The whole clinical notes line the condition was taken from, verbatim.

condition.description: The condition in the reader's words, lower case, abbreviations spelled out. The reader's normalisation of as_written, not the document's text.

context.description: Where in the document the mention sits, in the reader's words.

date.description: The date the reader took for the mention, YYYY-MM-DD; for a pathology request, the draw date. This is the fact time.

id.description: Identity, chosen by the reader: the lab's prefix, the lab number, "clinical-note", and the condition as a slug.

kind.description: What sort of mention this is, in the reader's words.

noted_by.description: Who wrote the mention, as the document names them; for a pathology request, the requesting doctor.
